test_title: PYST 6: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘no substitution required’.

This looks (like one of those unwelcome social summons which call upon a man) either to be bored or to lie.

options.text: like one of those unwelcome social summonses which call upon a man
like one of these unwelcome social summons that call upon a man
like one of those unwelcome social summon that call upon a man

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e.* 'like one of those unwelcome social summonses which call upon a man.'*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the underlined segment is incorrect because the** correct plural of 'summons'** is** 'summonses', **not **'summons'. **

Therefore, the **corrected sentence **would be: *"This looks like one of those unwelcome social **summonses** which call upon a man either to be bored or to lie."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• *'like one of these unwelcome social summons that call upon a man.*' changes the meaning slightly due to the use of 'these' instead of 'those' and it also keeps the incorrect plural form 'summons'.
 
• *'like one of those unwelcome social summon that call upon a man.'* also uses incorrect plural form 'summon'.
